test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required.

Abraham also had one sister, __of who__ not much has been recorded.
solution:
The correct answer is **'of whom**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is not **grammatically correct.**
 
• The error lies in the **underlined segment.**
 
• We need to **substitute** it with one of the options.
 
• **Whom** is the object form of who. We use **whom** to refer to people in formal styles or in writing when the** person is the object of the verb.__**
 
• So, as per the above information, instead of 'of who' in the above sentence, we are going to use** 'of whom' **as it is used with reference to the sister where the sister is the object of the verb.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
